t: Free laser cutting lesson plans from the laser maker Trotec.
steps: Find the Trotec education hub and read the lesson plans.
Sign up to download the Entrepreneurship, Esports, and STEM plans.
Read the privacy policy before you sign up.
Confirm that your school has a laser cutting machine and materials.
Ask IT and the facilities lead about safety and ventilation.
Choose a plan that fits your grade level.
Try the project yourself before class.
